工序智伴三维星环第三方组件说明

1. SaturnWebGL
Source: https://github.com/adelmassimo/SaturnWebGL
Commit: c960494e221d6a722b8fb5d9973d6d649d806f72
Copyright (c) 2018 Adel Massimo Ramadan
License: MIT. Full original license: saturn-webgl/LICENSE

Reused code: particle orbit equations from index.html#vertexShaderDEBRIS and
the corresponding base_angle, offsetX, offsetZ BufferGeometry attributes.
The original vertex shader is preserved in saturn-webgl/original-orbit.vert.glsl.

The adapted module saturn-webgl/particle-ring.js upgrades the BufferGeometry
API and adds bounded particle counts, violet/cyan point sprites and visible
moving clusters. Time is measured in seconds, with nonzero initial speed,
opposite directions, pause/resume and lifecycle cleanup. The source project's
audio, external textures, jQuery, statistics UI and old renderer are not used.

2. Three.js
Version: 0.187.0 (r187)
Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r187
Copyright 2010-2026 three.js authors
License: MIT. Full original license: three/LICENSE

three/three.module.min.js is bundled from the official npm package's
build/three.module.js using esbuild 0.25.12. Options: bundle=true,
minify=true, format=esm, target=es2022, legalComments=inline.
It is served locally, without a runtime CDN dependency. Versions and SHA-256
hashes are recorded in manifest.json.

3. Original project work
The page layout, procedural cloud material, atmosphere, interaction controls,
integration with the workbench and software engineering business workflow are
separate work in this repository. The third-party ring rendering is identified
as an open-source visual component, not claimed as an original AI innovation.

The previous CSS/SVG preview is retained at ../archive/planet-orbit-css-v2.html.
The WebGL preview requires a local HTTP server and WebGL2. If unavailable, the
page presents an explicit message and a link to the earlier preview.
